description: US median pay for a job title from PayScale's public salary research page: the title's compensation (USD, annual) and the related career-path roles with their pay. Pass the title as PayScale writes it in its URL, e.g. Software_Engineer. Figures are PayScale's published estimates. Related tools on this server, for a different need: jobs_indeed when you need Indeed job search: title, company, location, salary range; jobs_simplyhired when you need SimplyHired job search: title, company, location, salary. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

job.description: Job title as in the PayScale URL, e.g. Software_Engineer (letters, digits, underscores)
